Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 7, 2026

Clover helps you organize financial records, understand your money, and manage shared expenses. This policy explains what information we handle, why we need it, and the choices you have.

01
You stay in control

You choose what to upload, review, correct, share, or delete.

02
Sharing is intentional

Your personal financial records are not shared with a Circle unless you choose to share them.

03
We do not sell your data

Clover does not sell personal information or use it for behavioral advertising.

On this page

1. Who this policy covers

This Privacy Policy applies to Clover's website, web application, Help Center, contact forms, and related services. In this policy, "Clover," "we," "us," and "our" refer to the operator of the Clover personal finance service.

Clover determines how personal information is processed for the purposes described here. You can contact us about privacy at hello@clover.ph.

2. Information we collect
Account and profile information

This includes your name, email address, profile photo, authentication identifiers, account settings, onboarding answers, and the Profiles you create to organize different parts of your finances.

Financial records you provide

This includes bank statements, receipts, screenshots, spreadsheets, manual entries, account balances, transaction histories, investments, recurring activity, budgets, goals, and split-bill details.

Information Clover creates from your records

Clover may extract and organize transactions, merchants, categories, accounts, balances, holdings, line items, and dates. It may also create reports, trends, recurring-item suggestions, goal progress, import confidence scores, review items, and Adviser responses.

Shared and collaboration information

If you use Circles or Split Bills, we process Circle names, invitations, member roles, shared expenses, settlement status, shared budgets or goals, commitments, activity history, and the specific records or investment summaries you choose to share.

Billing information

For Pro subscriptions, we process your selected plan, billing interval, subscription status, payment-provider references, and transaction status. Payments are completed through the provider shown at checkout, including Paddle or PayPal where available. Clover does not receive or store your complete card or bank-payment credentials.

Usage, device, and support information

We may collect pages viewed, features used, button interactions, browser and device details, approximate location derived from network information, IP address, session and security events, diagnostics, and error information. If you contact us, we also process your message and any attachment you include.

3. Where information comes from
Directly from you when you create an account, upload records, enter information, or contact us.
From the files and financial records you ask Clover to process.
From other Circle members when they invite you or add information to a shared area.
From service providers that support authentication, payments, hosting, analytics, email, and security.
Automatically when you use Clover, such as usage, session, and diagnostic events.
4. How we use information

We use personal information to:

Create, authenticate, and maintain your account and Profiles.
Import, extract, organize, categorize, and display the records you provide.
Generate reports, patterns, goals, recurring suggestions, and Adviser guidance.
Operate Circles, invitations, shared expenses, and other features you choose to use.
Process Pro subscriptions and maintain billing entitlements.
Answer support requests and send important account, security, billing, or service messages.
Prevent abuse, investigate incidents, enforce our Terms, and protect Clover and its users.
Understand feature performance, troubleshoot errors, and improve the service.
Meet legal, accounting, regulatory, and dispute-resolution obligations.

Depending on the activity, we process information to provide the service you requested, with your consent, to comply with law, or for legitimate purposes such as security, support, fraud prevention, and product improvement. We apply the principles of transparency, legitimate purpose, and proportionality.

5. Imports, Adviser, and AI

Clover uses deterministic rules first where possible. When a file is unfamiliar, incomplete, image-based, or difficult to read, Clover may use optical character recognition or an AI service to extract and structure the information. Adviser also uses AI to respond to questions based on the financial context available in your account.

This means relevant text, images, extracted financial details, prompts, and account context may be sent to AI service providers solely to produce the requested result and operate the feature. AI output can be incomplete or wrong. Clover shows review and correction tools so you can confirm important details before relying on them.

Clover does not move money, approve credit, execute trades, or make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects on your behalf.

6. When information is shared

We do not sell your personal information. We may disclose it in these limited circumstances:

Service providers. Providers help us deliver authentication (Clerk), hosting and application infrastructure (Vercel), database services (Supabase), AI processing (OpenAI), payments (Paddle or PayPal), product analytics (PostHog), and support email (Zoho). They receive only the information needed for their role and process it under their own applicable terms and privacy commitments.
At your direction. We share information with Circle members, split-bill participants, or another recipient when you use a sharing feature.
Legal and safety reasons. We may disclose information when reasonably necessary to comply with law, a valid legal request, enforce our Terms, investigate fraud or abuse, or protect rights, safety, and security.
Business changes. Information may be transferred as part of a merger, financing, acquisition, reorganization, or sale of assets, subject to appropriate confidentiality and notice where required.
7. Circles and shared features

Joining a Circle does not automatically give its members access to your personal Profiles, accounts, transactions, files, reports, or full investment portfolio. Personal records remain private unless you deliberately share a supported item.

Members can see information created for the Circle and information another member explicitly shares there. Depending on your role, they may also see your display name, invitation status, contributions, settlement activity, and actions recorded in Circle history. Organizers can manage the Circle but cannot edit another member's private financial records.

Before sharing, check that a record does not contain information about someone who has not agreed to the disclosure. Removing yourself or unsharing an item may not remove information another member already lawfully received or shared history needed to preserve the Circle's records.

8. International processing

Clover and its service providers may process information in the Philippines and other countries where they operate. Privacy and data-protection rules may differ across locations. Where required, we use contractual, organizational, and technical measures intended to protect information transferred across borders.

9. Retention and deletion

We keep information only for as long as reasonably necessary to provide Clover, maintain traceability, secure the service, meet legal and accounting duties, and resolve disputes. Retention depends on the type of information and why it is needed.

Uploaded source files stored for server-side processing are temporary and marked for deletion after 72 hours. Cleanup jobs, failed processing, or backup expiration may take additional time. Some supported imports can be parsed locally without uploading the raw file.
Extracted and confirmed financial data remains in your account until you edit, delete, wipe, or close the account, or until retention is no longer necessary.
Billing, security, support, and audit records may be retained for legal, fraud-prevention, accounting, and dispute-resolution needs.
Backups, security logs, and records already shared with other users may take additional time to expire or may remain where law or another user's legitimate record requires it.

Wiping data removes Clover app data while keeping your sign-in account. Deleting your account removes the local Clover account and requests deletion of the associated Clerk identity. Manage and confirm subscription cancellation with the provider shown in your Plan settings before closing your account. Certain limited records may remain where required by law or for security and dispute handling.

10. How we protect information

Clover uses administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed for financial information. These include managed authentication through Clerk, encrypted network connections, server-side authorization checks, restricted database access, role and ownership checks, activity logging, and review tools that keep original and normalized import data traceable.

No service can guarantee absolute security. Keep your sign-in methods secure, use a strong unique password where applicable, and contact us immediately if you believe someone accessed your account without permission.

11. Your choices and rights

Subject to applicable law, including the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012, you may have the right to be informed, access your information, object to processing, correct inaccurate information, request erasure or blocking, obtain portable data, file a complaint, and seek damages where appropriate.

Clover also provides in-product controls to review and correct imported data, manage sharing, wipe app data, and delete your account. To exercise a right that is not available in the app, email hello@clover.ph. We may need to verify your identity and may retain or decline a request where permitted or required by law.

12. Cookies and analytics

Clover uses cookies and similar browser storage for sign-in sessions, security, theme and interface preferences, and reliable product operation. When analytics is configured, PostHog helps us understand page views, feature use, errors, and product performance. Clover does not use this information for third-party behavioral advertising.

You can control cookies through your browser, but blocking essential storage may prevent sign-in or cause parts of Clover to stop working correctly.

13. Children's privacy

Clover is not directed to children under 18 and is intended for people who can legally manage an account or who use it with valid parent or guardian authorization. If you believe a child provided personal information without appropriate authorization, contact us so we can review and take appropriate action.

14. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as Clover changes or legal requirements develop. We will post the revised policy here and change the effective date. If a change materially affects how we use personal information, we will provide additional notice where required.

15. Contact and complaints

For privacy questions or requests, email hello@clover.ph. Please describe your request and the email connected to your Clover account.

You may also learn about your rights or file a complaint with the National Privacy Commission of the Philippines.

1. Agreement and eligibility

These Terms of Service ("Terms") are an agreement between you and Clover. They apply to Clover's website, web application, Help Center, contact forms, and related services.

You must be at least 18 years old and legally capable of entering into this agreement, or use Clover with valid authorization from a parent, guardian, or authorized organization. If you use Clover for another person or entity, you confirm that you have authority to do so and to provide the relevant information.

If you do not agree to these Terms, do not create an account or use Clover.

2. Your account
Provide accurate information and keep it reasonably current.
Keep your password, sign-in method, and recovery options secure.
Do not share credentials or allow another person to impersonate you.
Tell us promptly at hello@clover.ph if you suspect unauthorized access.
You are responsible for activity performed through your account unless applicable law provides otherwise.

Clover may let one account create multiple Profiles for separate financial contexts. Profiles are organizational areas under the same account, not separate legal users or bank accounts.

3. What Clover provides

Clover is a personal finance information and guidance tool. Depending on your plan and available features, Clover may help you:

Import bank statements, receipts, screenshots, spreadsheets, and other supported records.
Organize accounts, transactions, categories, recurring activity, and balances.
Track investments, budgets, goals, reports, and financial patterns.
Ask Adviser questions based on the information in your account.
Create Circles, share selected items, and manage split bills or group plans.

Clover is not a bank, e-wallet, lender, broker, investment manager, credit bureau, remittance provider, or payment processor. Clover does not hold, move, lend, invest, or insure your money. References to financial institutions or brands describe supported records and do not imply endorsement or affiliation.

4. Your records and content

You retain your rights in files, financial records, messages, images, and other content you provide. You give Clover a limited, non-exclusive license to host, copy, transform, analyze, display, and transmit that content only as reasonably needed to provide, secure, support, and improve the service.

You confirm that:

You have the right to upload and process the content you provide.
The content and your use of Clover comply with law and do not violate another person's rights.
You will avoid uploading unnecessary sensitive information about other people.
You will review imported records and keep your own original documents where they are important.

Clover may preserve raw, parsed, and confirmed forms of import data separately to support review and traceability. Our handling of this information is explained in the Privacy Policy.

5. Imports, Adviser, and AI

Clover uses software rules, optical character recognition, heuristics, and AI services to interpret records and generate suggestions. Results may contain errors, omit information, duplicate entries, misunderstand a document, or become outdated.

You are responsible for reviewing imported transactions, balances, categories, investment details, reports, and Adviser guidance before relying on them. Your confirmation does not guarantee that an entry is complete or accurate, and Clover does not independently verify your information with a bank or other institution.

Adviser and other generated guidance are educational and informational. They are not personalized financial, investment, legal, accounting, credit, or tax advice and are not a substitute for a qualified professional. You remain responsible for every financial decision and action you take.

6. Circles and shared expenses

Circles are permissioned spaces for shared plans, selected financial summaries, expenses, goals, budgets, commitments, and activity. Joining a Circle does not make your personal financial records visible to other members unless you explicitly share a supported item.

Only invite people you trust and confirm the recipient before sharing.
Do not share another person's private information without permission.
Circle roles control collaboration features but do not transfer ownership of personal records.
A recorded split, contribution, or settlement is informational and does not itself transfer money or create a bank account.
Members are responsible for resolving disagreements about amounts, ownership, reimbursement, or settlement.

Clover may retain shared history needed to preserve an accurate Circle record, even after a member leaves, subject to the Privacy Policy and applicable law.

7. Acceptable use

You may not:

Use Clover for unlawful, fraudulent, deceptive, abusive, or harmful activity.
Upload malware, stolen data, or content you do not have permission to process.
Attempt to access another user's account, Profile, Circle, or private information without authorization.
Probe, bypass, disable, or interfere with authentication, authorization, rate limits, or security controls.
Scrape, overload, disrupt, reverse engineer, or copy the service except where law expressly permits it.
Use automated systems to create accounts, extract data, or send requests in a way that burdens or harms the service.
Misrepresent Clover output as verified professional advice or use it to make decisions about another person without appropriate review.
Use Clover or its output to develop or train a competing model or service without written permission.
8. Free and Pro plans

Clover may offer Free and Pro plans with different features, capacity, and limits. The current plan descriptions and prices appear on the Pricing page and at checkout. Features and limits may change as the service develops.

A temporary trial, promotion, higher limit, or uncapped feature does not promise that the same access will remain available indefinitely. We will provide notice where required before a material paid-plan change takes effect.

9. Billing and cancellation

Pro purchases use the billing provider identified at checkout, including Paddle or PayPal where available. Review the amount, currency, taxes, billing interval, and provider terms before approving payment. Regional pricing may differ; the checkout details govern your purchase.

Monthly and annual subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled.
Prices, billing interval, and any annual savings are shown before approval.
You are responsible for maintaining a valid payment method with your billing provider.
Use Plan settings or your provider’s customer portal to manage renewal and cancellation. Check the cancellation confirmation and the access end date shown for your subscription.
For Paddle subscriptions cancelled at the end of a billing period, access continues through that period. Other cancellation actions and promotional access follow their displayed terms.
Free Pro grants or referral rewards can have their own expiry dates and eligibility rules. Receiving a grant does not itself authorize a recurring charge.
Before deleting your account, confirm cancellation with your billing provider. Deleting an app from a device is not subscription cancellation.

Refund requests are handled under the applicable checkout terms, billing-provider policy, and consumer law. For Paddle purchases, see the Paddle Refund Policy. If a payment fails, is reversed, or is disputed, Clover may limit Pro access while the billing status is resolved.

10. Third-party services

Clover relies on third-party services for authentication, hosting, databases, AI processing, payments, analytics, and email. Their terms and privacy policies may apply to their part of the service. Clover is not responsible for a third-party service's independent acts, availability, or content, except where applicable law says otherwise.

Market data, exchange rates, institution labels, and other external information may be delayed, incomplete, or unavailable. Do not treat Clover as the official record of a bank, broker, merchant, tax authority, or payment provider.

11. Changes and availability

We work to keep Clover useful and available, but the service may be interrupted for maintenance, security work, provider outages, or other reasons. We may add, change, limit, suspend, or discontinue a feature. Beta or experimental features may be less reliable and may change without notice.

Keep copies of important original records. Clover is not a substitute for your bank statements, official receipts, tax records, or a dedicated backup system.

12. Suspension and termination

You may stop using Clover, wipe app data, or delete your account through the available settings. We may restrict or suspend access when reasonably necessary to investigate security risks, prevent harm, comply with law, address unpaid charges, or enforce these Terms.

We may terminate an account for a material or repeated violation. Where appropriate, we will give notice and a reasonable opportunity to correct the issue. Sections that by their nature should continue after termination, including ownership, disclaimers, liability, and dispute terms, will survive.

13. Clover ownership

Clover's software, design, branding, documentation, interfaces, and original content are owned by Clover or its licensors and protected by applicable intellectual-property laws. These Terms give you a limited, personal, revocable, non-transferable right to use the service; they do not transfer ownership.

If you send feedback or ideas, you allow Clover to use them without restriction or compensation, but you are not required to provide feedback.

14. Important disclaimers

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Clover is provided "as is" and "as available." We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability, complete accuracy, a particular financial result, or that every file, institution, transaction, or feature will be supported.

Nothing in these Terms excludes a warranty, consumer protection, or other right that cannot lawfully be excluded. Where such a right applies, these Terms are limited only to the extent the law allows.

15. Limits of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Clover will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, exemplary, or punitive loss, or for lost profits, opportunities, data, goodwill, or anticipated savings arising from the service.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Clover's total liability for claims related to the service will not exceed the greater of the amount you paid Clover during the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim or PHP 1,000. This limit does not apply where liability cannot legally be limited, including liability caused by fraud, willful misconduct, or another non-waivable basis.

16. Governing law and disputes

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of the Philippines, without regard to conflict-of-law rules. Before starting formal proceedings, please contact us so we can try to resolve the concern directly.

Where permitted by law, disputes will be submitted to the appropriate courts in the Philippines. Nothing here prevents you from using a regulator, consumer protection process, or court available to you under a non-waivable law.

17. Changes to these Terms

We may update these Terms as Clover, our providers, or legal requirements change. We will post the revised Terms and update the effective date. If a change is material, we will provide additional notice where required. Continuing to use Clover after the revised Terms take effect means you accept them.

18. Contact

Questions about these Terms can be sent to hello@clover.ph or through the Contact page.
